description: First production ruleset for technical sell-readiness assessment of surface-mesh 3D marketplace assets.

NO_MESH_OBJECTS.message_template: The 3D model contains no mesh objects.

ZERO_GEOMETRY.message_template: Mesh objects exist but contain no renderable geometry ({vertices} vertices, {faces} faces). V1 targets surface-mesh assets.

INVALID_BOUNDING_BOX.message_template: Bounding box spatial data is invalid: {reason}.

NO_MATERIALS.message_template: No material datablocks were detected in the deep analysis.

EXTERNAL_MISSING_TEXTURE.message_template: {count} referenced external image resource(s) are missing.

TEXTURED_MESH_WITHOUT_UV.message_template: Mesh '{mesh_name}' requires UV coordinates for material '{material_name}' but has no UV map.

EXPLICIT_UV_LAYER_MISSING.message_template: Material texture explicitly requests UV map '{requested_uv}' but mesh '{mesh_name}' only has: {available_uvs}.
